about: Robot_BIOBUZZ's components, in config.json's order. Frame: metres, +X forward, +Y left, +Z up, origin on the floor under the middle of the drive axles. Component c is drawn in model_c.glb as the CAD has it, at drawn_at_deg. To show it at angle a (degrees, the 'angle' named here), rotate it by t = a - drawn_at_deg about axis_direction through axis_point_m: the AdvantageScope pose is translation p - R(t) p, rotation quaternion (cos t/2, sin t/2 * axis_direction).

components.name: turret
components.angle: TurretSubsystem.angleDegrees(): degrees counter-clockwise from home (pointing along the nose), seen from above

components.name: flower stick
components.angle: FlowerStickSubsystem.commandedDegrees(): degrees swung out from stowed, 0 in, swingDegrees() (162) out; the commanded state, not a measured angle
